args.title: Reset busy state on export failure to re-enable Export button
args.body:
File: src/components/ExportButton.tsx

Change the ExportButton component to reset the busy state to false not only on success but also on failure by adding this reset in the catch or finally block. This prevents the Export button from remaining disabled when the exportReport fails.

label: bug
file: src/components/ExportButton.tsx
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The ExportButton component needs its busy state reset on failure as well as success. This prevents the Export button from staying disabled if the exportReport function fails, improving the user experience by allowing retry without page reload.
